title_en: Famous Chinese People (2/20): Tu Youyou and Artemisinin
note_en: 之所以 A，是因为 B puts the result first and the cause second: 之所以能有这个发现，是因为屠呦呦坚持了几十年的研究 "the reason this discovery was possible is that Tu Youyou kept at her research for decades." English usually says "A because B," but Chinese 因为 B，所以 A normally gives the cause first; 之所以…是因为… flips that order to stress the reason, much like English "The reason A is that B."
